plan: This attacks the per-simdgroup activation cost in decode 1x4864x896 f16. Each lane used to issue 96 scalar half loads for x, res and w, against only about 2 uint4 weight loads per column. Overloaded ld8 helpers now fetch 8 contiguous elements with one 16-byte load (half) or two float4 loads (float), with a scalar fallback for bfloat. All 12 activation vectors are loaded up front before any math, and the column-prefetch structure that wins is kept, so decode should gain and 16-column-per-simdgroup configs become cheaper to use.
from: run 20261005-142350, attempt 2-0 (decode champion, judged on Qwen 2.5 0.5B 4-bit shapes, float16, Apple M4)
